source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-wash Chinese mountain landscape with towering cliff columns, layered ridges, sparse winter trees, pines, small pavilion structures, and misty blank reserves around the massif. Calligraphy at the right side is excluded.

motifs.name: summit_plateau_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the upper central summit terrace with the small pavilion/house cluster, enclosing plateau edge, stepped paths, sparse trees, and surrounding cliff lip. Exclude the adjacent calligraphy and broad blank sky.
must_preserve: fine roof geometry with slanted tiled outlines
thin architectural wall lines
delicate twig-like trees around the buildings
soft pale wash on the plateau surface
broken ink contour defining the cliff edge
small dark accents marking shrubs and distant trees

motifs.name: upper_left_crag_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-left crag below the summit, including the rounded rock mass, vertical cliff face, small groves on the crown, and narrow mist gap beside it.
must_preserve: pale vertical rock wash
dry-brush contour cracks
clusters of short upright tree strokes on the ridge
soft mist edge separating the crag from the central mountain
light ink texture on ledges and cliff shelves

motifs.name: central_vertical_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the central stacked precipices with tall pale cliff columns, broken ledges, sparse pines and winter shrubs running down the middle of the composition.
must_preserve: long vertical cliff washes
fine angular rock outlines
dark shrub dots and short grass strokes along ledges
bare branching tree linework
layered ledge contours showing depth
soft transitions where mist leaves the rock faces pale

motifs.name: right_mid_pine_terrace
motifs.description: Isolate the right-middle terrace system with horizontal ledges, pine clusters, exposed cliff faces, and the pale open mist shape to its right, stopping before the calligraphy area.
must_preserve: flat ledge silhouettes
fine pine needle strokes and bent trunks
vertical rock texture in diluted ink
soft reserve of mist along the right edge
small shrubs rooted in cracks
subtle grey wash beneath the terrace shelves

motifs.name: left_foreground_needle_spires
motifs.description: Isolate the tall narrow rock spires on the left-middle foreground, including their pale faces, dark outer contour strokes, and sparse leafless trees growing from ledges and crevices.
must_preserve: slender tapering cliff silhouettes
dark dry-brush side contours
faint vertical wash streaks
tiny bare trees at the spire tops and bases
small ink accents marking cracks and ledges
mist-softened blank faces

motifs.name: serpentine_middle_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the central lower serpentine ridge that winds downward through the mountain, with rounded snow-like pale slopes, shrub rows, scattered pines, and layered terraces.
must_preserve: curving ridge contours
rows of short shrub and grass strokes following the slope
delicate bare tree branches
small pine canopies drawn with clustered needles
soft grey wash modeling the rounded terrain
clear negative-space bands between terraces

motifs.name: cliffside_hut_steps
motifs.description: Isolate the small hut perched on the right lower cliff with the short stair or path marks beneath it, adjacent rock face, and nearby sparse trees. Avoid the larger surrounding mountain mass where possible.
must_preserve: tiny pitched roof and wall geometry
short parallel stair/path strokes below the hut
nearby thin tree trunks and branches
pale vertical cliff wash behind the structure
dark ink accents defining the ledge
scale contrast between architecture and cliff

motifs.name: foreground_right_pine_bamboo
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground cluster at lower right: dark drooping bamboo-like foliage, pine branches, twisting trunks, rocks, and the small winding path or steps through the foreground ledge.
must_preserve: bold dark foliage strokes
drooping bamboo-like leaf clusters
pine needle sprays on branching limbs
twisting trunk linework
angular foreground rocks with dry-brush texture
small stepped path lines
strong contrast between dark ink vegetation and pale rock wash

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
